acreline.title: Acreline
acreline.blurb: WordPress real estate agency theme for land offices and farm brokerages — 21 Gutenberg blocks, listings, agents, and showing requests.
acreline.eyebrow: WordPress real estate agency theme · Farms & land
acreline.summary: Acreline is a WordPress real estate agency theme built for land offices, farm brokerages, and rural agents. Twenty-one Core Gutenberg blocks build the marketing pages. Searchable listings, map views, agents, and showing requests ship with Customizer identity and eight color styles — no Elementor or ACF required. Buy the pack for a self-serve install, or hire me to brand it and import your inventory.
acreline.challenge: Real estate agencies selling land, farms, and historic homes need acreage, township, and lot-type filters plus a map. Generic luxury realtor skins bury parcels and force IDX chrome agencies do not need. Rural brokerages deserve a theme built for how acreage buyers actually search.
acreline.approach: Marketing pages are real Gutenberg blocks with ServerSideRender previews — agencies edit them in the block editor without a developer. Listings, agents, and bookings stay as post types with classic metaboxes so brokers manage their own inventory. Identity and colors live in the Customizer. Filters are query args. Tools → Block Generator and Migrate to Blocks ship in the theme so agencies can build pages without writing PHP.
acreline.result: A marketplace-ready real estate agency pack: install the zip, brand it under Customize → Identity, seed demo inventory and block-built pages, and sell land the way rural buyers search for it. Agencies own the theme code — GPL means white-label and resale of services are both legal.
acreline.audience: Real estate agencies, land offices, farm brokerages, and rural agents who cannot use a suburban MLS skin. Also agencies that need a rural real estate base they can white-label for a client office.
acreline.architecture: Sage 11 + Blade + Tailwind v4 + Vite 8. Twenty-one server-rendered Core Gutenberg blocks for marketing pages (Block Generator + Migrate to Blocks). Listings, agents, and bookings as post types (optional Acreline Core so they survive a theme switch). Native SEO tags yield to Yoast / Rank Math / SEOPress / AIOSEO. Rank Math and Yoast both score well out of the box — listings include open-graph meta and structured post types for agency directories.
acreline.handoff: You own the theme zip, child theme, and Core plugin. Edit marketing pages in the block editor. Agencies and brokers edit parcels, photos, and agent fields in wp-admin metaboxes. HTML docs ship in the pack. Hire me to import your inventory, brand the Customizer, or wire a real MLS feed.

faq: Is Acreline a real estate agency theme or just a farm theme?

Both. Acreline is a full real estate agency theme built for rural offices — land brokerages, farm agents, and agencies selling historic homes or acreage. The listing filters and agent directory match how rural real estate agencies actually operate, not how suburban MLS portals work.
What do I get when I buy Acreline?

The marketplace pack: acreline.zip (upload in Appearance → Themes), optional child theme, Acreline Core plugin, and HTML documentation. Instant download after checkout. Hire me if you want branded installation or inventory import.
Is Acreline a live MLS or IDX theme?

No. It ships with demo inventory you manage in WordPress. Listings are a custom post type agencies edit in wp-admin. Wire a real MLS/IDX feed later — the UI does not depend on IDX chrome and the post type survives a theme switch via Acreline Core.
How does a real estate agency edit page copy?

Marketing pages use Core Gutenberg blocks with live ServerSideRender previews — your agents edit them directly in wp-admin. Listings, agents, and bookings use classic metaboxes. Brand, phone, and colors stay in Customize → Identity. No developer needed for day-to-day edits.
Can I white-label Acreline for a client real estate agency?

Yes. Theme code is GPLv2 or later. Sage / Acorn remain MIT (GPL-compatible). You can install it for a client agency, customize it, resell services on top, or fork it as a white-label base. The child theme is included for safe agency customization.
Do I need Elementor or ACF for Acreline?

No. Marketing pages use the included Gutenberg blocks. Listings and agents use metaboxes. Identity lives in the Customizer. Do not install a page builder — it adds no value and conflicts with the block architecture.
Can you install or customize Acreline for my real estate office?

Yes. Buy the pack for self-serve, or Get help and I brand it, import your listings, and hand off wp-admin editing to your brokers. I can also wire a real MLS feed or build custom listing filters for your market.

tocflow.title: TOCflow
tocflow.blurb: Free WordPress TOC block — accessible, SEO-friendly outline from your headings. Zero config.
tocflow.summary: TOCflow is a lightweight WordPress plugin that builds an accessible, SEO-friendly table of contents from your post headings. Free download for publishers who want a clean TOC without heavy JavaScript.
tocflow.challenge: Long posts need a jump list. Most TOC plugins ship a block library, client-only rendering, or settings you never touch — and the outline misses the first HTML response search engines and screen readers need.
tocflow.approach: One Gutenberg block (plus a shortcode). The outline is server-rendered. Anchors match heading ids. Collapse, sticky, and scroll-spy stay small and optional.
tocflow.result: Insert the block, publish, done. Free on this site and GitHub — a top-of-funnel plugin that shows how I ship focused WordPress tools.
tocflow.audience: Bloggers, docs sites, agencies, and developers who want a TOC without a bloated block pack. Also a free lead-in to hiring me for custom blocks or theme work.
tocflow.architecture: PHP block render callback, small editor script, optional ItemList JSON-LD. No React runtime on the front end for the list itself.
tocflow.handoff: Download the zip, activate, insert Table of Contents. Settings live under Settings → TOCflow. Source on GitHub if you want to fork it.
benefits: Zero config — insert the block; the outline builds itself
Server-rendered HTML for SEO and screen readers
Accurate anchors with aria-current while you read
Numbered or bulleted lists, five style presets
faq: Is TOCflow really free?
Yes. $0 checkout captures your email for update notices if you want them, or download from GitHub Releases. No freemium lock.
Does it work with classic editor posts?
Yes — use the [tocflow] shortcode. Heading anchors still inject on the front end.
Will it slow my site?
The list is in the first HTML response. Front-end JS is optional for sticky/scroll-spy and respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Can you customize it for my theme?
Yes. Get help for sticky-header offsets, style presets that match your brand, or a private fork.
tocflow.brand_tagline: One block. An accessible outline from your headings.
